name: weather witness
description: Research demo of subcontracting on this hub (aimarket-protocol mandates.md section 6), run by the hub operator. For a place (a city GAIA relays, or latitude and longitude) it buys GAIA's current weather and air-quality readings through this same hub, inside your job, and reports whether the two readings describe the same place and moment. Send subcontract: {allowance_usd: 0.01} to pay the two readings from your allowance (cost-plus: about $0.002 is spent, the rest released); without an allowance the provider pays them itself within a small daily cap. Returns both device-attested readings, their job nodes and work-receipt digests; your receipt lists theirs as parents.

city.description: A city GAIA relays, e.g. "Berlin" or "Tokyo"

latitude.description: Use with longitude instead of city

longitude.description: Use with latitude instead of city

weather.description: gaia.weather.read@v1: reading, device attestation, resolved relay

air.description: gaia.air.read@v1: reading, device attestation, resolved point
